read_only_post_error_state.interpretation: The normal abort boundary returned, cleared the pending status/detail and left the failed transaction unpublished. The machine did not hang in L65E.

actual_dispatcher_edge.evidence: The final ELF loads the context low/high bytes into __rc2/__rc3 at 0xaddb..0xade2 and then calls __call_indir; __call_indir is the single JMP (__rc18).

broken_leaf_prologue.failure: The leaf overwrites the valid context argument before its first read because it incorrectly declares the pointer argument to be A/X.

historical_witness.behavior: The compiler-generated C entry reads the context directly from __rc2/__rc3 and never copies A/X into them.

linked_abi_finding.gate_gap: The Link-46 assembler-leaf inventory verified symbol/size and repeated the leaf's declared ABI, but did not prove the real dispatcher-to-leaf dataflow. Gate and leaf therefore shared the same false convention.

non_authoritative_reproduction.purpose: CPU/ABI differential only; Xemu is not hardware acceptance evidence.
non_authoritative_reproduction.method: A diagnostic shim calls the immutable Link-46 leaf at entry+4, skipping only the two context-destroying instructions. The table and all remaining renderer bytes are unchanged.

recommended_class_c_cut.product_change: Delete only STA __rc2 and STX __rc3 at the L65E entry and correct its ABI comment; the entry then consumes the dispatcher-owned __rc2/__rc3 pointer exactly like the former C implementation.
recommended_class_c_cut.gate_change: Extend the assembler-leaf ABI gate to the actual vm_runtime_overlay_exec_family indirect callsite and reject either prologue write before the first context read. Pin mutations for low-byte overwrite, high-byte overwrite and A/X reintroduction.
recommended_class_c_cut.verification: Run the product-shaped WPLTO and all existing L65E/leaf/capacity gates; a new promotable product link and hardware rerun require separate Class-C authorization.

claim_limit: Hardware First Red, read-only final-ELF diagnosis and non-authoritative CPU/ABI differential only. No product source fix, new product link, promotion, acceptance or release is claimed.
